text:
mira: starting canary for quetzal11b (int4). intermittent OOMs on long gens (>1200 tokens) at ~3% repro.

sanjay: paste failing log tail pls.

mira: log snippet:
```
2026-03-22T18:12:03Z ERROR oom at alloc_kv cache=1.2GB slot=0xabc
2026-03-22T18:12:03Z INFO req=abc123 max_new_tokens=2048 batch=1
2026-03-22T18:12:03Z WARN fragment_count high, consider evict/compact
```

eli: large max_new_tokens + int4 > kv blowup. quetzal's attention causes KV growth spikes and fragmentation. kv_shrink default is off.

mira: current canary config string: { model: quetzal11b, quant: int4, batching: auto, max_new_tokens_default: 2048, kv_shrink_policy: off }

jen: propose mitigations: lower max_new_tokens_default -> 1024, kv_shrink_policy -> aggressive, set compact_on_evict=true, enable batch_pacing windowed (max_batch_delay=8ms), soft-reserve KV 48MB.

eli: + run eval harness with 2x long-gen prompts under load to catch regressions. note: int4+kv_shrink may cause tiny quality delta.

mira: plan applied to canary. ops-bot acknowledged (ticket ML-4821).

ops-bot: canary config rolled to 3 nodes https://infra.redwood/canaries/quetzal11b :thumbsup:

mira: 30m canary metrics: OOMs 3->0, p95 latency +5%, token-cost -12%, quality delta 0.4% on instruction eval.

jen: looks safe. suggest slow rollout and OOM alert at >1% over 10m.

eli: if we see quality >0.7% degrade, try hybrid-int6 for FFN layers (weights int6, KV int4) to reduce frag.

qa-squad: adding regression test and long-gen load job to CI.

mira: thanks all, will monitor and update this thread.
